description: This file defines an abstract class 'ToDoEvent' for event handling related to ToDoItem objects within a GWT (Google Web Toolkit) application. It manages an event bus and provides methods to access ToDoItem data and the global event bus.

classes.name: ToDoEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing events related to ToDoItem objects, with access to a global event bus and the specific ToDoItem involved.

methods.name: ToDoEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with a specific ToDoItem.

methods.name: getToDo
methods.description: Returns the associated ToDoItem for this event.

methods.name: getGlobalEventBus
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton global EventBus for event dispatching.
